title: Transport and journeys
source_note: Original ForLanguage content informed by recurring travel/transport themes in user-provided recent-review materials; no recalled prompt copied verbatim.
format_reference: British Council public Aptis ESOL General Speaking format.

tasks.prompt: How do you usually travel on a normal working or study day?
What is the most convenient form of transport where you live?
What do you usually do during a long journey?
Describe the picture and explain what the travellers may be discussing.
tasks.review_note: Original picture prompt using ForLanguage artwork.

tasks.prompt: Tell me about a journey when your original travel plan changed.
What can people do to make shared journeys more comfortable?
Compare travelling by city bus with travelling by bicycle.
Which option is more practical for a short daily journey in a busy city?
What could cities do to encourage people to use cars less often?

Describe a transport problem that affected one of your journeys. How do transport choices affect quality of life in cities? Should convenience or environmental impact be the main priority when transport systems are planned?
